definitions.evaluable: simulated patients treated and on study through the endpoint's sampling day (this run's count)
definitions.p_requirement: Bayesian bootstrap of this run's patients at the target enrolment (4,000 draws, fixed stream)
definitions.sae_rate_simulated: simulated cohort incidence of any serious adverse event (this run)
definitions.sae_rate_arm_level: historical arm-level estimate from comparable registry trials (evidence, not a simulated value)
definitions.withdrawal_rate_simulated: share of this run's patients who withdrew (on treatment or from follow-up)
definitions.withdrawal_rate_predicted: registry protocol-burden model's prediction for this protocol
definitions.scenarios: each scenario reports its own values; scenarios that do not change a quantity carry the original value exactly

derivations.eligibility: each simulated candidate's eligibility outcome; sequential funnel removes a candidate at the first category it fails
derivations.gain_if_relaxed: candidates who fail only that criterion
derivations.evaluable: treated and on study through the endpoint's sampling day (end of treatment or death ends it); sample collection itself is not simulated
derivations.evaluable_probability: Bayesian bootstrap of the simulated patients (4,000 draws), joint across endpoints
derivations.recruitment: log-normal fitted to the planning report's historical accrual percentiles; duration = enrolment / rate
derivations.objectives: P(every evaluable count meets its requirement) x P(all primary hypotheses succeed at the design ratios)
